mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the matrix-conformance fact lets Alloy invent an Operation whose (role, kind) pair is not in the permission matrix — directly violating least privilege. The injected fact forces an AuditOfficer attempting LookupPatient, which the matrix forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.callerRoleSnapshot = AuditOfficer and op.kind = LookupPatient }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the gating fact, a Permitted lookup can exist with no matching CareTeamMembership row. The injection forces exactly that counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = LookupPatient and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = op.caller and m.patient = op.targetPatient) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the per-lookup audit fact lets a LookupPatient operation exist without any AuditEntry referencing it — the classic 'access without audit' failure mode the spec forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some op: Operation | op.kind = LookupPatient and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.op = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the at-most-one-per-op constraint lets two distinct AuditEntries reference the same Operation, which is the structural signature of a mutation/duplicate write against the append-only log.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.op = ae2.op }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the snapshot-equality fact lets an AuditEntry's recorded clinician differ from the operation's actual caller — i.e. misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.clinicianSnapshot != ae.op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the byte-equivalence fact, a Denied operation can return PermittedShape while NotFoundOrDenied returns NotFoundShape — observable leakage of patient existence to non-care-team clinicians.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ResponseLeak { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Denied and op.response = PermittedShape }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the authentication-required fact lets an unauthenticated Operation slip through the system — the exact bypass FR-001 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthOp { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = False }
